get.description: Labels for MITRE ATT&CK technique ids from the pinned offline index, with its notice.

`namespace`: that capa namespace or below; `attack`: an ATT&CK technique id (its
sub-techniques included) or sub-technique id.

post.description: Enrich a succeeded analysis job's IOC set (sample hashes first, then by count).

get.description: `library`: case-insensitive exact DLL name; `q`: substring of function or library.

Versioned JSON report of a succeeded static analysis (an audited download; the
evidence custody chain is unchanged: the evidence bytes are not read).

409.description: Not a static analysis, or it has not succeeded.

post.description: Queue an analyzer run over the evidence (re-runs keep earlier jobs as history).

get.description: The provider catalog with this org's configuration status (never a key).

put.description:
Store a key (sealed, write-only), enable/disable, acknowledge terms, set limits or the
MISP base URL. A new key is checked after the commit (`ti.verify`) within the same
per-provider limit as POST .../verify; `verify_queued` says whether it was.

post.description: Queue a check of the stored key (the enrich worker calls the provider).
Raw request body = the evidence bytes (streamed, hashed, stored; never parsed).

Manual IOC lookup: a per-value normalization report plus the run (if any value is
eligible for a requested provider).

get.description:
Every stored answer for the normalized indicator, newest first (400 `invalid_ioc`
when the value cannot be normalized; `skipped` says why no provider would receive it).

The run with one page of its items, each with its result (`from_cache` when the
answer came from an earlier run).
